title: Higher order partial derivatives
goal: Take second partial derivatives ($f_{xx}, f_{xy}, f_{yx}, f_{yy}$) to measure how a 3D surface bends, and use the shortcut that mixed partials match ($f_{xy} = f_{yx}$).

beforeThis.skill: Notation tip: in $f_{xy} = \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y \, \partial x}$, differentiate with respect to $x$ first, then differentiate that result with respect to $y$.

links.label: Precalculus: Power functions and chain/quotient expressions

seeIt.creator: sumchief
seeIt.watchFor: Computes $f_{xx}$, $f_{yy}$, $f_{xy}$, and $f_{yx}$, then checks that the mixed partials match.

questions.asking: Differentiate step by step with respect to the indicated variable while holding the other variable fixed as a constant.
questions.statement:
Find the specified partial derivatives.

  1. $f(x, y) = x^2 y^3$; $\; f_{xx}(x, y), \; f_{xyy}(x, y), \; f_{yxy}(x, y)$
  2. $f(x, y) = e^{xy^2}$; $\; f_{xx}(x, y), \; f_{xy}(x, y), \; f_{xxy}(x, y), \; f_{xyy}(x, y)$
  3. $f(u, v, w) = \dfrac{1}{u + 2v + 3w}$; $\; \dfrac{\partial^3 f}{\partial w \partial v \partial u}(u, v, w), \; \dfrac{\partial^3 f}{\partial w \partial v \partial u}(3, 2, 1)$

questions.asking: Find all four second-order partial derivatives ($f_{xx}, f_{xy}, f_{yx}, f_{yy}$) of $f(x, y) = \sqrt{x^2 + 5y^2}$.
questions.statement: Find all second partial derivatives of $f(x, y) = \sqrt{x^2 + 5y^2}$.

questions.asking: Compute both $f_{xy} = (f_x)_y$ and $f_{yx} = (f_y)_x$ explicitly and show that the two expressions are equal.
questions.statement:
$$f(x, y) = \frac{\tan(xy)}{\ln x}$$

Verify Clairaut’s theorem by showing $f_{xy} = f_{yx}$.
